title: "Killing and Managing Child Processes"
---

# Killing and Managing Child Processes

Always terminate child processes gracefully using `SIGTERM` before resorting to `SIGKILL`:

```bash
kill -TERM "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true

# Enforce a hard timeout with GNU timeout
timeout --preserve-status --kill-after=5s 30s long_running_task
```
